items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: I got to hear that band here in San Francisco, Elvin and McCoy and Jimmy Garrison, Trane.

ctx.x: All right. “Trane Ballads” I love that record, that band, I got to hear that band here in San Francisco, Elvin and McCoy and Jimmy Garrison, Trane. And I’ve got to put some Miles in there, which one? Maybe “Milestones.” Is that the one with “Billy Boy?”
Yes it is and the tune called “Miles.” [scats]. I love that record.
